t: Weird or What? With William Shatner: Alien Encounters
d: Strange events suggest that aliens are among us. In Colorado, a farmer discovers a cow mutilated by unknown forces, a Texas man is repeatedly abducted from his bed, and in Ohio, an astronomer's powerful telescope intercepts a mysterious message.
Embark on an eye-opening journey as experts investigate the startling mysteries captured by satellites orbiting the Earth: from hidden worlds to unexplainable natural phenomena.

A volcanic island off the coast of Antarctica with a mysterious past is explored. In the Peruvian Andes, the mummified remains of a teenage girl are discovered. A shipwreck is found near Russia’s Franz Josef Archipelago.

Archeologists in Russia unearth an astonishing number of mass graves. A World War II era American military plane is found on a Canadian mountain. Strange cosmic rays coming from Antarctica’s ice has physicists stumped.

A Kazakh farmer discovers ancient burial sites that may determine whether or not the legend of the Amazon women warriors is myth or reality. In the Italian Alps, a group of hikers explore long forgotten military infrastructure.

t: Secrets In The Ice: The Vanishing Of Flight CS-59
d: A secret underground military research station in the middle of the Greenland Ice Sheet is revealed as one of the most elaborate cover stories in the history of the Cold War.

t: Secrets In The Ice: Curse Of The Ice Princess
d: Merging advanced scanning technology and scientific research, this series investigates curiosities that have been lost for millennia, or never seen before, exploring how and why they ended up in the most desolate and distant corners of the planet.

A giant naval vessel is located on the bottom of the Norwegian Sea. An ancient reptile-like creature unknown to science is found in the permafrost of Canada’s Arctic. In Scotland, archaeologists are drawn to a strange, figure-eight shaped ditch.

t: Secrets In The Ice: Ancient Ice Zombies
d: Thirty World War II aircraft all crashed in the same spot on the Greenland Ice sheet, causing experts to wonder if they all fell victim to the Arctic’s Bermuda Triangle.

A secret military base is discovered a few hundred miles from the North Pole. A man-made, ancient stone formation is found 120 feet below the surface of Lake Huron. A 1500 year old burial ground is discovered on the shores of the Baltic Sea.
